conviction_note: The quarter should land near a lowered and disputed bar: Q3 Chilean export prices fell about 7% from Q2, yet Albemarle's realised price held flat. The Q4 price guide will almost certainly be lower, with Chilean spot at $16-17.5/kg in October and China spot down about 39% since late August. The stock has already fallen 35% since late August and 10% since Albemarle printed. Last two prints were bought (+7.1% and +5.3%) on volume guidance. Findings net to 0; p_up 51 on a 7-point absolute move gives +0.14.
bar: Disputed. Earnings Whispers (preview dated 2026-11-10): Q3 EPS $1.94 on revenue of about $2.26bn (https://www.earningswhispers.com/article/SQM/23119). findings.finding: Q3 price: Chile's central-bank lithium carbonate export price was about $19.4-19.75/kg through Q3 (Jul and Aug about $19.75 and $19.525 spot on Aug 19; September average $19,368/t). Q2 ran about $20.8-21.7k/t (May $21,674, June $20,825), against SQM's Q2 Novandino realised price of about $21.8/kg. So Q3 realised is likely 5-9% lower QoQ, whereas management guided 'relatively stable'. The Earnings Whispers consensus ($1.94 EPS, $2.26bn, about -16% and -8.5% QoQ) already embeds a decline of roughly that size.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 2026: an EPS miss on price ($1.28 vs $1.60) was bought +7.1% because volume guidance rose. Q2 2026: a price-driven beat bought +5.3%. A modest price softness has not been what sold this stock on the print.
findings.source_note: Monthly figures in https://www.riotimesonline.com/chile-lithium-price-october-2026/ (2026-10-23), citing La Tercera's reading of Banco Central de Chile data. The Q2 realised $21.8/kg comes from https://pulse2.com/sqm-lithium-sales-hit-record-84100-metric-tons-as-chile-realized-prices-jump-nearly-160/
findings.why_not_priced: The series is public, but in Chile-only Spanish-language press. Consensus is already 16% below Q2 EPS, which looks like the decline is partly in the bar. If the market had read the series as a bigger miss, sell-side Q3 numbers would sit below $1.94, and they do not (Benzinga shows $2.17).
findings.independence: Albemarle's flat Q3 realised price (separate finding, separate document) points the other way. PLS's -14% spodumene price points the same way for the International segment. Customs data includes Albemarle's exports, so this is an aggregate proxy, not SQM's own number.

findings.finding: Albemarle's Q3 2026 Energy Storage realised price was $20.02/kg (8-K, Nov 4), about flat on its Q2 price of roughly $20/kg. That shows lagged and index-linked contracts held realised prices through Q3 even as spot fell. ALB beat a lowered bar ($2.58 vs $2.56 EPS, $1.55bn vs $1.49bn revenue) and rose about 3.6% on Nov 5 despite guiding Q4 lower.
findings.link: Both companies produce lithium from brine in Chile's Salar de Atacama and sell carbonate and hydroxide to the same Asian cathode and cell makers. About 40% of ALB's salts volume is on long-term contracts; SQM prices on shorter index-linked terms with a lag. Lithium is about 72-78% of SQM's revenue and gross profit.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: SQM's last two prints rose 5-7% whatever the EPS surprise sign. ALB's own reaction to a beat with a Q4 cut was +3.6% (AI recap, approximate).
findings.why_not_priced: SQM fell about 10% after ALB's print while ALB held up, which suggests the market read ALB's Q4 cut onto SQM more than its flat Q3 realised price. If the Q3 read-through were priced, SQM would have tracked ALB's post-print bounce. Capped small because the bar is disputed.
findings.independence: Reaction from https://www.allinvestview.com/earnings/ALB/q3-2026/ (AI recap). ALB's Q2 price of about $20/kg is from https://www.riotimesonline.com/lithium-markets-latam-tuesday-november-3-2026/. Cuts against the Chile export-price finding; the two are different measures (contract book vs FOB spot), not contradictory facts.

findings.finding: Q4 guide: Chile's export price averaged $17,513/t in October to the 20th, with a daily $16,050 on Oct 20 (September $19,368). SMM battery-grade carbonate in China was 91.7k yuan/t on Nov 5, against about 150k in late August and 143.5k futures on Sep 8. Albemarle guided Q4 sales and EBITDA lower on 'lower market pricing'. SQM's lagged pricing points to a Q4 realised price perhaps 15-25% below Q3, while street Q4 EPS of $1.90-2.10 sits at or above the Q3 bar.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: SQM trades on the forward line. Q1 2026 rose 7.1% on a raised volume guide despite the miss. In Q3 2024, a lower price outlook cost about $1bn of market value (mining.com, older).
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced in the share price: -35% since late August, -10% since ALB, 1.4% above the 52-week low. Not obviously in the Q4 estimates, which at $1.90-2.10 look stale against a 39% fall in China spot. If the estimates had caught up, Q4 street EPS would sit well below Q3's $1.94, not level with it. The finding is sized below the implied move because the stock has done much of the work.
findings.independence: Chile figures from https://www.riotimesonline.com/chile-lithium-price-october-2026/ (2026-10-23). ALB's Q4 guide from its 8-K. findings.why_not_priced: This is a measure of what is priced, not an unpriced fact. Its value is that the real bar is now below consensus. Had the market not de-rated SQM for Q4, it would have tracked ALB, not fallen 10% after it.

findings.finding: Volume guide: SQM's 2026 lithium volume guide is about +15% over 2025, raised at Q1. Q1 was 69kt and Q2 84.1kt, and Q3 was guided in line with Q2 (about 84kt), so YTD is about 237kt. Against a 2025 base of roughly 234-250kt (Q1 about 55, Q2 53.1, Q3 72.9 and Q4 about 66kt+ for Novandino), +15% means about 270-290kt, which implies Q4 well below Q3. Management talked of hopes for a stronger Q4, so a raised full-year volume guide is likely.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The last volume guide raise (Q1 2026, +10% to +15%) was met with +7.1% despite an EPS miss.
findings.why_not_priced: This is my own arithmetic on company figures; no preview states it. The 2025 base is uncertain (one AI summary gives 2025 production of about 234k), and SQM may already have nudged the guide at Q2 without wire coverage. A raise in a falling price market is worth less than in May, so sized small.
findings.independence: Q2 volume of 84.1kt from https://pulse2.com/sqm-lithium-sales-hit-record-84100-metric-tons-as-chile-realized-prices-jump-nearly-160/. 'Stronger Q4' from https://finviz.com/news/420662/sqms-earnings-have-tripled-but-its-stock-has-slumped-q3-must-show-the-lithium-upswing-holds. Chile carbonate exports of about 23.4kt in July, 24.1kt in August and 18.9kt in September (SMM) are consistent with Q3 volume holding up.

findings.finding: International segment (Mt Holland spodumene): PLS's September-quarter 2026 realised spodumene price was $1,809/t (SC5.2, CIF China), down about 14% QoQ. SQM's Q2 International realised price was about $2,048/t, so SQM's International price likely fell in Q3. Analysts had already flagged that segment as lagging on price.
findings.link: Same product (spodumene concentrate, Western Australia) sold to the same Chinese converters on similar index terms. SQM's International segment is its 50% of Mt Holland/Covalent, a minority of SQM lithium volume (roughly 10-15%, my estimate). The other 85-90% is Chilean brine.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: There is no record of SQM trading on its International segment alone.
findings.why_not_priced: It is public and small. Sized net of the Chilean 85-90%, which this does not touch.
findings.independence: Same direction as the Chile export-price finding but a separate document and product.

baseline_tension: The baseline has no skew and a thin option market (6.01% indicative move). The negative Q4 guide finding agrees with the 35% de-rating and 13.7% 20-day fall, so it is largely priced. The expectations and reaction-history findings cut the other way, and the set nets to zero.
lessons_applied: Rule 6 (bar disputed: Earnings Whispers $1.94/$2.26bn vs Benzinga $2.17/$2.34bn): capped the two reported-quarter price findings, Chile export price -0.5 to -0.4 and the ALB peer +1.0 to +0.6; p_up from 52 to 51.
Rule 5 (inference beats nothing but loses to documents): volume-guide-raise arithmetic shrunk from +0.7 to +0.5 because the 2025 base is uncertain.
Rule 9 (segment net of the rest): PLS spodumene finding from -0.3 to -0.2, since International is about 10-15% of lithium volume.
Final rule (untrustworthy FPI history): reaction history rebuilt from confirmed releases (+7.1%, +5.3%, about +5%) and used for abs_move_pct = 7.0 instead of the baseline's 6-K median.
Rule 7: short interest checked before the negative Q4 finding; not crowded, so the negative was not shrunk for a squeeze. The Q4 finding was left at -2.0.
